purpose: Compare current GitHub Pages responses for the Dungeons page and its 19 screenshot objects against exact local v52 bytes.
source_basis: Parent-requested fixed set after local browser inspection reported ten decoded thumbnails and nine original HTTP 200 responses. No current hosted object was fetched during preparation.

policy.remaining_body_budget_rule: Each attempt cap is min(4 MiB, remaining per-object bytes, remaining batch bytes); direct and transport-failure proxy attempts share budgets.
policy.proxy_fallback: Process-local http://127.0.0.1:7890 only after a direct transport failure; no retry for HTTP status, MIME, or hash mismatch.
policy.retry_after: Record Retry-After and set cooldown to max(120 seconds, parsed Retry-After); no retry inside this batch.
policy.raw_response_storage: runtime/private/raw/ (body, headers, cookie jar, stderr per attempt)
policy.public_projection: Only object URL, expected local byte count/hash, observed status/content type/byte count/hash/effective URL, timing, attempt count, and match result.

interpretation_boundary: A remote hash match proves the current response matches the selected local v52 object, not historical originality. A mismatch identifies a deployment/content difference only; it does not by itself explain the earlier user-visible issue.
